resources.string: Convert Samsung Notes .sdocx exports into a portable Markdown / Obsidian-compatible ZIP archive.
Notes Escape is an independent local migration utility for Samsung Notes .sdocx exports.
.sdocx is Samsung Notes’ export format. Select exported files or a folder and create one portable ZIP archive.

Samsung Notes → Open or select a note → Save as file / Share → Samsung Notes file → .sdocx
Menu wording may vary by Samsung Notes version. Do not choose DOCX or PDF when you want an SDOCX conversion.
Typed text, Unicode and RTL text, images and media where present, handwriting as SVG where supported, attachments, and optional original .sdocx files.

Some Samsung Notes formatting may not convert exactly. Complex tables, formulas, proprietary objects, or newer and older SDOCX variants may be partially converted. Locked notes must be unlocked in Samsung Notes before export. Original page layout is not guaranteed. Rich formatting support varies by Samsung Notes version. Original .sdocx files can be preserved in the migration ZIP.
Notes Escape is an independent migration utility and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Samsung.

Conversion runs locally on this device. Files are not uploaded or shared. There is no account, advertising, analytics, backend, or Internet permission. You choose the source files and ZIP destination with Android’s file picker. Temporary cache files may exist during conversion and are cleaned on completion, cancellation, failure, and app startup.
Contact: artbyte@126.com
